paragraph: All you have to do is **sign** your name here. Did you forget to **sign** your name again? If you exist, please give me a **sign**.
english: to make (a document) official by writing one's signature
arabicDesc: مثال: كل ما عليك هو إمضاء إسمك هنا.

other.meaning: to write one's signature on a document

paragraph: I see the **type** of person that you are. What **type** of business do you want to start? I can't understand the **type** of person she is.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نمط، طراز

other.meaning: To put text on paper using a typewriter (verb)

paragraph: The **price** of oil is down this week. They agreed on a **price**. **Prices** are high these days.
english: cost required to gain possession of something
arabicDesc: مثال: هبط سعر البترول هذا الأسبوع.

other.meaning: cost of an action or deed

paragraph: Were you able to **pass** the test? Could you **pass** me the water, please? I don't know what will **pass**.
english: to go by, over, or through
arabicDesc: مثال: أنجحت في الإختبار؟

other.meaning: to go from one person to another
to advance through all the steps or stages necessary to validity or effectiveness

paragraph: Are you sure you don't want to **sell** it? Will you **sell** your house to him? Would you like to **sell** your car?
arabicDesc: مثال: أأنت واثق أنك لا نريد بيعه؟

other.meaning: to agree to transfer goods or provide services for payment

paragraph: We are **humans** and we are from Earth. All **humans** are good at heart. But how can a **human** being know all that?
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن بشرٌ، ونحن من كوكب الأرض.

paragraph: I sent it to you two days **ago**. I first used a computer about 40 years **ago**. I should have done this years **ago**.
arabicDesc: مثال: بعثتُه لك منذ يومين.

paragraph: The nation demands **social** justice. The people demand **social** justice. You can change your **social** condition through hard work.
arabicDesc: مثال: الأمة تطلب العدالة الاجتماعية.

paragraph: Read these books, or at any **rate** this one. At that **rate** it would take her all night. At any **rate**, it's all the same to me.
english: the proportional relationship between one amount, value etc. and another

other.meaning: the price of a(n individual) thing; cost

paragraph: Finding a good place to live isn't **easy**. This book is **easy** for me to read. Written in **easy** English, the book is **easy** to read.
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس سَهلًا أن تعثر على مكانٍ جيدٍ للعيش.

paragraph: I went for a **walk** in the park. I usually go for a **walk** every morning. He has to **walk** in the water.
arabicDesc: مثال: ذهبت لأتمشى في المتنزه.

other.meaning: to take for a walk or accompany

paragraph: I want to **spend** more time alone with you. You can **spend** the night with us if you want. I would like to **spend** the rest of my life with you.
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أقضي وقتًا أكثر معك وحدنا.

paragraph: I know that you must have a **million** questions. If you had a **million**, what would you do? Now we have one and a half **million** members.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ١٠٠٠٠٠٠

paragraph: A good question is the **half** of knowledge. I'll see you in the meeting room in **half** an hour. Right now, it is **half** past ten.
english: one of two roughly equal parts into which anything may be divided
arabicDesc: مثال: حسن السؤال نصف العلم.

paragraph: He **often** lies on the bed and reads. I've not seen her **often** at school. Do you **often** write to your parents?
arabicDesc: مثال: عادة ما يستلقي على السرير للقراءة.

paragraph: I'm old enough to **vote**. I don't know who I'm going to **vote** for. I thought that I had the right to **vote**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا كبير بما يكفي للتصويت.

paragraph: The baby seemed to be sleeping a **sound** sleep. I did not hear a **sound** from her the entire night. It didn't **sound** right to me.
arabicDesc: مثال: بدى الصبي نائما نوما عميقا.

other.meaning: The strait that separates Zealand (an island of Denmark) from Scania (part of Sweden) (noun)

paragraph: What is the hardest language, in your **view**? Try to see it from his point of **view**. We each have our own **view** of the world.
arabicDesc: مثال: من هي اللغة الأصعب بنظرك ؟

paragraph: Do you know the **boy** in the picture? The **boy** was searching for the lost key. This is the **boy** I think about.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف الولد في الصورة؟

other.meaning: Exclamation of surprise, pleasure or longing (interjection)

paragraph: He needs to do some **research**. How much money does your company spend on **research**? I haven't picked that **research** up in a while.
arabicDesc: مثال: عليه أن يجري بحوثا.

paragraph: I might be **okay** with having no friends now. Is it **okay** if I ask you a question? **Okay**, let's get back to the matter at hand.
Have you ever heard that **song** sung in French? Every time I listen to this **song**, I cry. I wrote a **song** about what happened here last year.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سبق و أن استمعت لهذه الأغنية بالفرنسية؟

other.meaning: the act or art of singing

paragraph: We traveled through the **south** of France. He must be from the **South**. How many **South** American countries have you been to?
arabicDesc: مثال: سافرنا عبر جنوب فرنسا.

paragraph: Is it **true** that you came across a bear? What they told you is not **true**. It may or may not be **true**.
english: concurring with a given set of facts
arabicDesc: مثال: أصحيح التقيت بدب؟

paragraph: I wouldn't know how to **begin**. When did you **begin** studying English? Now let's **begin** the game.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعرف كيف سأبدأ.

paragraph: Today, he is not allowed to **eat** anything sweet. We **eat** to live, not live to **eat**. Do you **eat** at home or **eat** out?
english: to ingest — see also consume, ingest
arabicDesc: مثال: اليوم، غير مسموح له أن يأكل أي شيئا حلوا.

paragraph: He's taking a **history** test. What kind of bad **history** does that house have? I will tell you the **history** of my life.
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يجري امتحانا في التاريخ.

paragraph: I know this sounds a little **bit** crazy. He's a **bit** shorter than me. Things have changed a **bit**.
english: a binary digit, generally represented as a 1 or 0
arabicDesc: مثال: أعلم أنّ الأمر يبدو جنونيّا نوعا ما.

paragraph: It's not the final goal, but the **process** of getting there that matters. It's a very slow **process**. How long is this going to take to **process**?
english: series of events to produce a result
arabicDesc: مثال: إنها ليست الهدف النهائي, ولكن العملية للوصول إلى هناك هي ما يهم.

other.meaning: path of succession of states through which a system passes
To perform a particular process on a thing (verb)

paragraph: She doesn't admit that she is in the **wrong**. I think that I didn't do anything **wrong**. It's the **wrong** way to do it.
arabicDesc: مثال: انها لا تعترف بانها مخطئة.

other.meaning: asserting something incorrect — see also be wrong

paragraph: He read the book from **cover** to **cover**. Women shouldn't have to **cover** their faces. Don't try to **cover** up.
arabicDesc: مثال: قرأ الكتاب من الجلدة إلى الجلدة.

paragraph: We can't live without **air** and water. When will the next episode **air**? Without **air**, nothing could live.
english: 1. mixture of gases making up the atmosphere of the Earth
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس بإمكاننا العيش بدون هواء أو ماء.

other.meaning: 2. the apparently open space above the ground

paragraph: He continued his work after a **short** break. To cut a long story **short** - she won and I lost. He tried writing a **short** story.
english: having a small distance between ends or edges
arabicDesc: مثال: تابَع العمل بعد استراحة قصيرة.

paragraph: Love is not just a feeling, but also an **art**. Science is the **art** of seeking the truth. **Art** is long, life is short.
english: the creative and emotional expression of mental imagery, such as visual, auditory, social, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: الحبّ ليس مجرّد شعور بل هو فنّ أيضا.

paragraph: Your son is **almost** a copy of your father. She was **almost** late for school. I **almost** forgot where I was.
arabicDesc: مثال: ابنك يكاد أن يكون نسخة من أبيك.

paragraph: That has happened to me **several** times. His car turned over **several** times before falling into the river. There are **several** ways to measure speed.
english: consisting of a number more than two, but not very many
arabicDesc: مثال: حدث ذلك لي مرّات عدّة.

paragraph: Those **present** were all against the plan. It is so nice of you to give me a **present**. I will **present** myself at the meeting.
arabicDesc: مثال: جميع من حضر عارض تلك الخطة.

other.meaning: The current moment or period of time (noun)
To bring (someone) into the presence of (a person) (verb)

paragraph: Not a **star** was to be seen that night. The smaller a **star** is, the longer it lives. The door had a big gold **star** on it.
english: senses derived from the apparent shape of a star in the sky when blurred by the eyes to have streaks
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كوكب، نجمة

other.meaning: (astronomy) a luminous celestial body made of plasma

paragraph: This **project** will take at least a year to finish. You won't finish this **project**. This is my favorite **project**.
arabicDesc: مثال: سيستغرق المشروع سنة على الأقل.

paragraph: We need **action**, not words. Your words don't match your **actions**. He is what is called a man of **action**.
english: something done so as to accomplish a purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: نحتاج إلى العمل وليس الكلام.

paragraph: He arrived with a **pretty** girl on his arm. A **pretty** girl like you will definitely be noticed. I'm **pretty** sure that's how it happened.
english: pleasant to the sight or other senses
arabicDesc: مثال: إنهُ وصل مع فتاة حسناء علي ذراعهُ.

paragraph: How did you get into the **building**? He parked his car behind the **building**. No man lives in the **building**.
english: closed structure with walls and a roof
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف دخلت إلى المبنى؟

paragraph: The man spoke in a **low** voice. No, the building is not high, it is **low**. How **low** do you think the markets can go?
english: in a position comparatively close to the ground
arabicDesc: مثال: تكلم الرجل بصوت خافت.

paragraph: Can you **account** for all the money you spent? We should take into **account** she is still young. You must on no **account** do such a thing.
I'm not as **nice** as you think I am. It was **nice** of you to say that. I told her that you're a **nice** girl.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا لست لطيفًا كما تظنني.

other.meaning: having a pleasant taste or aroma
A coastal city, the capital of Alpes-Maritimes department in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region in southeast France (noun)

paragraph: He makes it a **rule** to take a walk every morning. You should not go against the **rules**. You must follow the **rules**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هو لديه عادة أن يمشي كل صباح.

other.meaning: To regulate, be in charge of, make decisions for, reign over (verb)

paragraph: Their job is to **cut** up the wood. **Cut** it out, will you? She **cut** down a tree.
english: to divide with a sharp instrument
arabicDesc: مثال: عملهم هو قطع الأخشاب.

paragraph: This is too good a chance to **miss**. You shouldn't **miss** the opportunity to see it. There are times when I **miss** him.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه فرصة أكبر من أن تفوّت.

other.meaning: to feel the absence of someone or something; to feel the want or need of

paragraph: I thought you might want to come **along**. Trees are planted **along** the street. My cat and dog get **along**.
english: by the length of; in a line with the length of; lengthwise next to
arabicDesc: مثال: ظننت أنك قد تود مرافقتي.

other.meaning: in a line with, with a progressive motion on; onward on; forward on

paragraph: I didn't want **anyone** to know where I was. Could you bear **anyone** to treat you like that? I won't talk to **anyone** anymore, except to you.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أشأ أن يعلم أحدا أين كنت.

paragraph: I'm **happy** that you did that for me. He tried to make his wife **happy**, but he couldn't. I'm so **happy** to see you again.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا سعيد لأنّك فعلت هذا من أجلي.

paragraph: Have you made a **note** of her new address? I wrote her a **note** that I'll be out. You might want to make a **note** of that.
english: mark, or sign, made to call attention
arabicDesc: مثال: هل كتبت عنوانها؟

paragraph: I met him on the **street** the other day. I found this ring on the **street** this morning. I spent hours walking up and down on this **street**.
english: paved part of road in a village or a town
arabicDesc: مثال: قابلته في الطريق ذلك اليوم.

paragraph: He helped me **build** this house. They want to **build** a house. They saw me leaving the **building**.
english: (transitive) to form by combining materials or parts
arabicDesc: مثال: هو من ساعدني على بناء هذا المنزل.

paragraph: I'm going to help you **save** some time. You are the only one who can **save** the world. Can you **save** this seat for me?
english: to help someone to survive, or rescue someone
arabicDesc: مثال: سأساعدك في توفير بعض الوقت.

paragraph: I haven't seen you since the **break**. Let me **break** this down for you. Can I take a **break** now?
english: to separate into two or more pieces, to fracture or crack, by a process that cannot easily be reversed for reassembly
arabicDesc: مثال: ما رأيتك منذ العطلة

other.meaning: An instance of breaking something into two or more pieces (noun)

paragraph: That was **probably** what influenced their decision. You are **probably**, once again, right. He's **probably** up in his room.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان ذلك على الأرجح ما أثّرَ على قرارِهِم.

paragraph: These things I've told you I know from **experience**. You have a lot of **experience** in computers, don't you? We learn from **experience** that men never learn anything from **experience**.
english: the effect upon the judgment or feelings produced by any event, whether witnessed or participated in
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه الأشياء التي أخبرتك بها أعرفها من خبرة.

paragraph: Do you know who owns this **land**? Is there some **land** for sale here? This house and this **land** are mine.
english: part of Earth that is not covered by oceans or other bodies of water
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف صاحب هذه الأرض؟

other.meaning: To descend to a surface, especially from the air (verb)

paragraph: I thought you liked to **learn** new things. I want to **learn** Chinese, but the characters are difficult. We will **learn** a new song today.
arabicDesc: مثال: ظننتُكَ تحب تعلم أشياءَ جديدة.

other.meaning: to make use of a bad experience
to gain knowledge from a bad experience so as to improve

paragraph: I broke his **heart**, but I love him. I don't want to talk to you, because you broke my **heart**. I say this from my **heart**.
arabicDesc: مثال: فطرت قلبه ولكني أحبه.

paragraph: I'll get in touch with you by **phone** tomorrow. I'm going to buy a cell **phone** tomorrow. I was about to go out when the **phone** rang.
arabicDesc: مثال: سأتواصل معك عبر الهاتف غدا.

paragraph: People who will **lie** for you, will **lie** to you. He seems to have told a **lie**. I told a **lie** against my will.
arabicDesc: مثال: من سيكذب لأجلك، سيكذب عليك.

paragraph: English is an **international** language. It's best to make **international** calls person to person. Can I make an **international** call with that phone?
english: of or having to do with more than one nation
arabicDesc: مثال: الإنجليزية لغة عالمية.

other.meaning: Someone who has represented their country in a particular sport (noun)

paragraph: I don't know anything about his **past**. Everything was better in the **past**. School begins at half **past** eight.
english: period of time that has already happened
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعرف شيئاً عن ماضيه.

paragraph: The day will come when space travel becomes **possible**. I want an answer from you as soon as **possible**. It is certainly **possible** if you want it.
english: able but not certain to happen
arabicDesc: مثال: سيأتي يوم سنستطيع أن نستمتع بالسفر في الفضاء.

paragraph: I like animals, for **example**, cats and dogs. We should follow his **example**. You should set a good **example** to your children.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أُحب الحيوانات, على سبيل المثال, القِطط والكلاب.

paragraph: The **film** was not what I had thought it was. I'm really looking forward to seeing that **film**. Don't let the kids watch this **film**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الفيلم ليس الفيلم الذي فكرت انه هو .

paragraph: I didn't **expect** to ever see him again. Did you really **expect** him to tell you the truth? What do you **expect** to find here?
english: to look for, look forward to, anticipate
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أتوقع أن أراه ثانية، أبدًا.

paragraph: She came here as **soon** as she heard it. I'm sure that she will come back **soon**. Return this book as **soon** as you can.
arabicDesc: مثال: أتت إلى هنا فور ما سمعت بالأمر.

paragraph: He **claimed** he knew you well. Here no one is what they **claim** to be. He knows better than to make such a **claim**.
arabicDesc: مثال: زعم أنه يعرفك جيدا.

paragraph: I asked why he was **required** to do that. Different types of data **require** different types of tests. Some subjects **require** a deeper understanding gained over time.
arabicDesc: مثال: سألت لم كان عليه أن يقوم بذلك.

paragraph: Let me have a look at the **picture**. Could you take a **picture** of me and my friends? He showed us a **picture** of his mother.
english: representation of visible reality produced by drawing, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: دعني ألقي نظرة على الصورة.

paragraph: Our success was **due** to his efforts. He failed, **due** to lack of money. The woman they were **due** to call has left.
english: expected or required at a certain time; owed
arabicDesc: مثال: نجاحنا ثمرة لمجهوداته.

paragraph: I watched a new episode of the **series**. Breaking Bad is my favorite **series**. Dark is the best German **series**.
english: a number of things that follow on one after the other or are connected one after the other
arabicDesc: مثال: شاهدتُ حلقة جديدة من المسلسل.

paragraph: Don't think you're **special**, because you're not! You'll always have a **special** place in my heart. All I want is someone **special** in my life.
english: distinguished by a unique or unusual quality
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تعتقد انك مميز، لانك لست كذلك!

paragraph: She had suffered a heart **attack**. **Attack** is the best defense. Word spread of the **attack**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هي تعرضت إلي نوبة قلبية.

paragraph: I found out that her **son** is a doctor. I'll try my best to help your **son**. My **son** talks about you all the time.
english: a male person in relation to his parents
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد اكتشفت أن ابنها طبيب.

other.meaning: One of the three persons of the Trinity, believed to have become incarnated as Jesus Christ (noun)

paragraph: My name doesn't **appear** on the list. I waited for an hour, but he didn't **appear**. I do not **appear** to be getting any younger.
english: to come or be in sight; to be in view; to become visible
arabicDesc: مثال: اسمي لم يظهر في القائمة.

other.meaning: to seem; to have a certain semblance; to look

paragraph: The **site** for the new school has been bought. We are going to make this **site** better together. Oh, this is the best **site**, by the way!
english: the place where anything is fixed

other.meaning: place where anything is fixed; situation; local position

paragraph: What do you want to be in the **future**? I want a better **future** for my children. She dreamed of their **future** together.
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا تريد أن تصبح في المستقبل؟

other.meaning: Having to do with or occurring in the future (adjective)

paragraph: The **development** team is already working on another project. Those who will run in the election promised **development**. Weight increase is the easiest method for personal **development**.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تعمير، تطور

paragraph: Do I have to **answer** all of the questions? I called her last evening but she didn't **answer**. Have you found an **answer** to this question?
english: to make a reply or response to
arabicDesc: مثال: هل علي أن أجيب علی أسئلتك كلها؟

paragraph: We left the **final** decision to him. We have to put off making a **final** decision until next week. The decision is not **final**.
arabicDesc: مثال: تركنا القرار الأخير إليه.

paragraph: I did not find any **data** from the system. We don't have time to process all this **data**. I think we have all the **data** we need.
english: facts and numbers collected to be studied

paragraph: The old church stands **north** of the town. My house is in the **north** of the city. How long are you going to be up **north**?
arabicDesc: مثال: الكنيسة القديمة تقع في شمال المدينة.

paragraph: I feed my cat every **morning** and every evening. We got up at four in the **morning**. I have been working since six this **morning**.
english: part of the day between dawn and midday
arabicDesc: مثال: أطعم قطتي كل صباح وكل مساء.

other.meaning: the part of the day after midnight and before midday — see also AM

paragraph: Don't worry. I'm not going to tell the **police**. The **police** tracked down the other three students. If you don't leave us alone, I'm calling the **police**.
english: local or general law enforcement agency
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تقلق. أنا لن أقول للشرطة.

paragraph: You got those from a **field**? What's your **field** of work? What **field** are you in?
english: land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتَ حصلت على هؤلاء من الحقل؟

other.meaning: wide, open space used to grow crops or to hold farm animals
place where a battle is fought
course of study or domain of knowledge or practice

paragraph: Keep on going. You'll see a **bank** on your left. I have to go to the **bank** today. Is this place far from the **bank**?
arabicDesc: مثال: استمر ، سترى البنك على يسارك.

paragraph: Can you **pick** me up at the station? **Pick** up your things and go away. Don't forget to **pick** me up tomorrow.
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك أن تأتي لأخذي من المحطة؟

paragraph: Which color do you like more, blue or **red**? The card you drew was a **red**, wasn't it? I have a new **red** car.
arabicDesc: مثال: أي لون تفضل؟ الأزرق أم الأحمر؟

paragraph: My house is the **third** house on the right. All you needed to say was the **third** part. I'll leave the second or **third** of next month.
english: the ordinal form of the cardinal number three
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ثالثة

other.meaning: The person or thing in the third position (noun)

paragraph: You are not in a **position** to ask for anything. I'm not in a **position** to accept it. We should be in a **position** to help you.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتَ لستُ في موقف يسمح لتسأل عن أي شئ.

paragraph: I never for a **moment** imagined that I would win. Can I talk to you a **moment**? I didn't think it was the **moment**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أكن أتخيل للحظة أنني سوف أفوز.

paragraph: At the water **source**, I sat waiting. I can't reveal my **sources**. I heard about it from another **source** last year.
english: the person, place, or thing from which something (information, goods, etc.) comes or is acquired
arabicDesc: مثال: في منبع الماء، جلست منتظرا

paragraph: I am his friend and will **remain** so. I would like her to **remain** just the way she is. Why did he **remain** in Germany?
english: to stay behind while others withdraw
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا صديقه و سأبقى كذلك.

paragraph: **Clear** the road. It's not safe. The details of the project have not been **clear** for the last two months. All your doubts will be **cleared** soon.
arabicDesc: مثال: افسحوا الطّريق. إنّ الوضع غير آمن.

paragraph: My father used to be a **strong** man. Love is **strong**, but money is **stronger**. He is **strong** as a horse.
english: capable of producing great physical force
arabicDesc: مثال: أبي اعتاد أن يكون رجلاً قوياً.

other.meaning: capable of withstanding great physical force

paragraph: I know I don't have any **chance** of winning. I gave you a **chance**, but you didn't take it. Don't give up. You still have a **chance**.
arabicDesc: مثال: اعلم بانه ليس لدي اي فرصة للفوز.
